item.title: Da Hoodzeum turns radical Black history into living archive
item.description: The Madison Children’s Museum hosted Feb. 19 its Black Heritage Month Celebration. This event was free and open to the public, featuring food, music, art and dance that represented Black culture and traditions. item.title: Upcoming Imagination Center invites four finalists to propose public art
item.description: In October 2025, four finalists were selected to propose public art designs for the forthcoming Imagination Center at Reindahl Park. The finalists, chosen by the Madison Arts Commission, were selected from a pool of 32 applicants for their work’s reflection of the Reindahl Park area’s history, according to The City of Madison’s announcement.
